Azizul Hakim on ‘Mithur Muktijuddho’
2019-12-30T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/azizul-hakim-mithur-muktijuddho-1846873

Acclaimed actor and director Azizul Hakim is set to play a key role in Zahid Shaon’s upcoming film, Mithur Muktijuddho. It is a government granted film, set in the backdrop of the Liberation War of Bangladesh. “I have always been drawn to stories about the Liberation War and I am excited to be working on this film,” said Azizul Hakim. The shooting for Mithur Muktijuddho will start on January 10, 2020, in Jhenaidah, where Azizul Hakim will be staying for a week. He will return to Dhaka to work on a television serial afterwards.
